title: Pull hand-rolled inputs, buttons and bare pages back toward the kit (raw-input ratchet was raised, 190 raw buttons in five builder files, 46 pages with no template shell)

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: scripts/adoption-baselines.json: raw-input baseline 75 (direction raised, 'Create a Space v3 hero builder (create-space-steps) ... added raw inputs'), raw-textarea 3 raised, shadow-literals 47 raised. Raw <input> in 188 places in app/components; worst: app/sign-in/page.tsx 7, app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx 7, app/(main)/connections/new/creator.tsx 7, components/frequency/site/pages/create-space/create-space-steps.tsx 7, app/sign-in/frequency-sign-in.tsx 6. || git grep '<button' in app/components non-test = 2,316 (ratcheted: raw-button-bg baseline 124 lowered, handrolled-icon-button 1, so most are styled via classes). Worst files: components/sites/editor/shell.tsx 74, app/(main)/admin/library/loom-grid.tsx 30, components/journey/v2/journey-editor.tsx 27, components/sites/editor/canvas.tsx 25, entity-blocks/profile-page-builder.tsx 23, builder/shell/builder-shell.tsx 23, app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx 22, components/on-air/session.tsx 20. || scripts/templates-baseline.txt lists 46 entries: wizards (@wizard intercepts, 6 legit), hunts/* 7 (dark), join/(induction) 3, sign-in, app/page.tsx, hosted/[host]/*, admin/{appearance,crm/pipeline,events,walkthroughs}/[id], connections/[id], edit/[slug], scan. 3 are documented gate blind spots.

WHY IT MATTERS: Sign-in and join are the highest-traffic forms and bypass the field primitive (focus ring, error and label wiring). Ratchet is raised so it protects nothing here. Mostly ratcheted and bg-class debt is already low, so this is polish; the join induction flow is the only high-traffic offender. Already ratcheted, set may only shrink. Real candidates are admin detail pages and connections/[id].

FIX DIRECTION: Convert sign-in and induction inputs to components/ui/field, then re-freeze lower. Convert join/induction and on-air buttons to ui/button; leave editor internals. Convert admin/*/[id] and connections/[id] to DetailTemplate/AdminTemplate.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
